name: GPU Geometry Assembly and Coordinate Conversion
aliases: GPURenderer Face Triangulation and Coordinate Conversion
definition: Converts raw voxel face data into typed arrays (position, normal, uv, index, color) for GPU upload, handling coordinate system conversion and winding order correction.
summary: GPU Geometry Assembly and Coordinate Conversion transforms raw voxel faces into GPU-ready typed arrays while explicitly handling coordinate system conversion and triangle winding correction.
